messages:
omar: kicking off index add on user_settings (idx_last_active) in staggered backfill window 23:30-02:30 UTC. plan: start with low-rate readers, run migration mig/v5.4.0. pinned version: mig/v5.4.0. fallback: mig/v5.3.9 if we need to roll back.

deploybot: canary started for mig/v5.4.0 on az-east-2 (canary 8%). canary id: dpl-1810. logs: deploybot://canary/1772109999

riley: watching replica lag and replica apply rates. set alert: replica_lag > 10s for 3m -> page #oncall.

jen: added rollback snippet to release notes. quick stop: `./pause_backfill --id mig/v5.4.0` then `./drain_workers --tag idx_user_settings` followed by `./unpin_migration mig/v5.4.0 --target mig/v5.3.9`

opsbot: monitoring rule: write amplification > 2x baseline -> post to #eng-sre and increment ticket.

omar: starting ramp to 10% with command: `./backfillctl start --mig mig/v5.4.0 --rate 10% --shard-filter 'hot!=true'`

deploybot: ramp to 10% done. metrics: p50 write: 28ms, p95: 130ms, p99: 410ms. replica lag median: 1.2s, one replica spike 12s. KV cache pressure +9%.

riley: that 12s replica spike on r-3 is worrying. hold ramp. marking r-3 as impacted in routing.

omar: putting ramp on hold. tagging `replica_backpressure=true`. anyone see db locks?

jen: small advisory locks seen on user_settings row-level on s-11, max 6.8s. posted query sample in thread.

riley: setting shard throttle: `./backfillctl set-rate --shard s-11 --rate 5%` and isolating r-3 from canary traffic.

deploybot: shard rate updated, canary adjusted. worker pool scaled to 3 for healthy shards, 1 for s-11.

opsbot: redis queue length for backfill workers increased on s-11 -> 300. suggested taper: per-shard exponential decay for 15m.

omar: applying taper: `./backfillctl taper --shard s-11 --decay 0.6 --duration 15m`. also disabling aggressive checkpointing to reduce small tx pressure.

jen: noted. updated runbook: if replica_lag persists >15s or p99 writes > 600ms for 5m -> trigger full pause and unpin to mig/v5.3.9. command: `./unpin_migration mig/v5.4.0 --force --drain=true`

riley: after taper p99 dropped to 320ms, replica r-3 lag back to 2.4s. queue drained to 80 over ~90s.

omar: good recovery. propose gradual resume to 25% in 10m with shard-level caps. any objections?

jen: +1. keep the fallback playbook warmed. I'll open a short-lived release-note edit: add the exact unpin commands and who to DM if locked.

riley: prepping fast-unpin script on-call: `#!/bin/bash
./pause_backfill --id $1
./drain_workers --tag idx_user_settings --timeout 120
./unpin_migration $1 --target mig/v5.3.9`

deploybot: starting resume to 25% with shard caps. will report at completion.

opsbot: outgoing alert cleared. will continue to watch for replica_lag >5s events.

omar: thanks team. keep p99, replica lag, and queue depth in your sights. will post final summary when we hit 100%.
